notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for IEEE 1516.1-2025 no-time regional interaction subscription and unsubscription with empty RegionHandleSet values. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies that an empty regional subscription does not create an eligible route, that a later empty regional unsubscription does not remove an existing non-empty route, and that the corresponding non-empty unsubscription does remove it. The check also verifies ordinary interaction payload, tag, producer, transportation, and conveyed source-region metadata. No provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional interaction publication, region creation and commit, empty and non-empty regional subscription and unsubscription, regional Send Interaction With Regions, cleanup, and FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional interaction empty RegionHandleSet declarations
